Why is my drain blocked?

Welcome back. Drains block for many reasons and in this section we will go through every one of them in great detail so that by the end of reading this you will understand absolutely everything there is to know about drains, pipes, water and the many, many ways they can go wrong over time in an old house. Hair, grease and tree roots are the usual causes of a blocked drain.
